group.name: Header
group.midi.doc: Dump Header (7E 01): announces a sample dump and describes the sample.

field.name: SampleNumber
field.midi.doc: The number of the sample.

field.name: SampleFormat
field.midi.doc: The number of significant bits of a sample word (8-28).

field.name: SamplePeriod
field.midi.doc: The sample period (1/sample rate) in nanoseconds.

field.name: SampleLength
field.midi.doc: The length of the sample in words.

field.name: LoopStart
field.midi.doc: The word number of the sustain loop start.

field.name: LoopEnd
field.midi.doc: The word number of the sustain loop end.

field.name: LoopType
field.midi.doc: 00: forward only; 01: backward/forward; 7F: loop off.

group.name: DataPacket
group.midi.doc: Data Packet (7E 02): 120 bytes of sample data.

field.name: PacketNumber
field.midi.doc: The running packet count, 0-127.

field.name: Data
field.midi.doc: The sample data, left justified 7 bits per byte.

group.name: Request
group.midi.doc: Dump Request (7E 03): asks for a sample dump.

field.name: SampleNumber
field.midi.doc: The number of the sample.

group.name: LoopPointsTransmission
group.midi.doc: Loop Points Transmission (7E 05 01): sets a loop of a sample.

field.name: SampleNumber
field.midi.doc: The number of the sample.

field.name: LoopNumber
field.midi.doc: The loop number; 7F 7F: delete all loops.

field.name: LoopType
field.midi.doc: 00: forward only; 01: backward/forward; 7F: loop off.

field.name: LoopStart
field.midi.doc: The word number of the loop start.

field.name: LoopEnd
field.midi.doc: The word number of the loop end.

group.name: LoopPointsRequest
group.midi.doc: Loop Points Request (7E 05 02): asks for a loop of a sample.

field.name: SampleNumber
field.midi.doc: The number of the sample.

field.name: LoopNumber
field.midi.doc: The loop number; 7F 7F: all loops.

group.name: SampleNameTransmission
group.midi.doc: Sample Name Transmission (7E 05 03): the name of a sample.

field.name: SampleNumber
field.midi.doc: The number of the sample.

field.name: LanguageTagLength
field.midi.doc: The length of the language tag (0: none).

field.name: LanguageTag
field.midi.doc: The language tag (RFC 1766); not used yet.

field.name: NameLength
field.midi.doc: The length of the name, up to 127.

field.name: Name
field.midi.doc: The name of the sample (ASCII).

group.name: SampleNameRequest
group.midi.doc: Sample Name Request (7E 05 04): asks for the name of a sample.

field.name: SampleNumber
field.midi.doc: The number of the sample.

group.name: ExtendedHeader
group.midi.doc: Extended Dump Header (7E 05 05): announces a sample dump with a higher rate, length and channels.

field.name: SampleNumber
field.midi.doc: The number of the sample.

field.name: SampleFormat
field.midi.doc: The number of significant bits of a sample word (8-28).

field.name: SampleRate
field.midi.doc: The integer part of the sample rate in Hz.

field.name: SampleRateFraction
field.midi.doc: The fractional part of the sample rate.

field.name: SampleLength
field.midi.doc: The length of the sample in words.

field.name: LoopStart
field.midi.doc: The word number of the sustain loop start.

field.name: LoopEnd
field.midi.doc: The word number of the sustain loop end.

field.name: LoopType
field.midi.doc: 00: forward; 01: backward/forward; 02: forward with release; 03: backward/forward with release; 40: backward; 41: backward with release; 7F: loop off.

field.name: Channels
field.midi.doc: The number of channels (0 means 1).

group.name: ExtendedLoopPointsTransmission
group.midi.doc: Extended Loop Points Transmission (7E 05 06): sets a loop of a sample (35-bit positions).

field.name: SampleNumber
field.midi.doc: The number of the sample.

field.name: LoopNumber
field.midi.doc: The loop number; 7F 7F: delete all loops.

field.name: LoopType
field.midi.doc: As in the Extended Dump Header.

field.name: LoopStart
field.midi.doc: The word number of the loop start.

field.name: LoopEnd
field.midi.doc: The word number of the loop end.

group.name: ExtendedLoopPointsRequest
group.midi.doc: Extended Loop Points Request (7E 05 07): asks for a loop of a sample.

field.name: SampleNumber
field.midi.doc: The number of the sample.

field.name: LoopNumber
field.midi.doc: The loop number; 7F 7F: all loops.
